Interface DBPreparedStatement

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, DBStatementBase
public interface DBPreparedStatement extends DBStatementBase
A simplified JDBC prepared statement with just the methods needed by MSFX.

The SQL command is given when the statement is prepared, with a ? for each parameter. Parameters are set by index, starting at 1, with one setter per type of Types, named and typed as in Value, and keep their values until set again, so the statement can be executed or added to the batch many times setting only the parameters that change.

Setters of object values accept null, which sets the parameter to SQL NULL, the same as setNull(int, Types).

Author:
Miquel Sas
